review.rationale: The frozen Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the supplied original specification and source evidence. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 consistently require live, read-only wrapper counts from the existing limiter while preserving Promise behavior, scheduling, and clearQueue. The source confirms index.js and the directly maintained index.d.ts are implementation owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts the appropriate regression owners; package.json establishes the xo && ava && tsd verification entry point without a declaration-generation build. The exact four-file binding scope is appropriate and does not require gratuitous edits. Stable requirement, acceptance, and task keys agree across the specification and Gold. The implementation/independent-verification task split and verification dependency are explicit. The catalog contains only a non-auto-assignable reviewer with no capability claims, so neither execution task has an eligible member. That active project reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier independent-review prerequisite without implying execution eligibility. No material unresolved business Decision is supplied, so reaching assignments and blocking there with both abstained-no-eligible reasons is appropriate. Gold and preview release-input fingerprints agree for repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, policy, model, sampling, and budgets. These are accepted as Service-calculated bindings, not independently recomputed hashes. The manifest-specific sourceDigest is a separately labeled fingerprint and is not treated as an assertion that it equals releaseInput.sourceDigest. The isolation evidence states that this Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle; retained historical operations are not treated as fresh candidate evidence. Approval concerns the independent expectation only, not execution, human attestation, or completion of the remaining negative controls.
